name: WF-ANI-AVA · 8930 Inbound Caller Lookup v1.0
description: Retell inbound_call_webhook for 414-240-8930 (AVA SALES). Looks up caller by ANI in GHL, returns dynamic_variables: caller_known, caller_first_name, caller_cell_e164, caller_timezone_label, recent_web_activity, has_upcoming_appointment, appointment_time_c

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const d = s => ((s == null ? '' : s) + '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''); const from = d($('Extract').item.json.from_number).slice(-10); if (!from || from.length < 10) return 'NO'; const list = ($json.contacts || []); const hit = list.find(c => d(c.phone).slice(-10) === from); return hit ? 'YES' : 'NO'; })() }}

assignments.name: contact
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = s => ((s == null ? '' : s) + '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''); const from = d($('Extract').item.json.from_number).slice(-10); return ($json.contacts || []).find(c => d(c.phone).slice(-10) === from) || {}; })() }}
